content.title: How to watch Mavericks vs. Nuggets: TV channel and streaming options for March 25
content.text: The Dallas Mavericks (23-49) will try to end a four-game losing streak when they hit the road to take on the Denver Nuggets (45-28) on March 25, 2026 at Ball Arena.How to watch Dallas Mavericks vs. Denver Nuggets Venue: Ball Arena Time: 10 p.m. ET TV: KFAA, ALT, KTVD Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Dallas vs. Denver odds Spread: Denver -11.5 (-110), Dallas +11.5 (-110) Favorite Moneyline: Denver -625 Underdog Moneyline: Dallas +450 Total: 244.5 Total Over Odds: -115 Total Under Odds: -105 Odds provided by BetMGM.Injury reportsNuggetsPeyton Watson: Day-To-Day (Hamstring)MavericksDereck Lively II: Out For Season (Foot), Kyrie Irving: Out For Season (Knee), Caleb Martin: Out (Foot), Daniel Gafford: Questionable (Shoulder), Brandon Williams: Questionable (Concussion Protocol)Stats to know The Nuggets score 120.9 points per game (just 1.9 more points than the 119.0 the Mavericks give up). The Mavericks average just 2.7 fewer points per game (113.8) than the Nuggets allow their opponents to score on average (116.5).
